READ-ONLY design-consistency audit. Do NOT edit anything. Base dir: /opt/nxeon

You are auditing marketing pages against a GOLD-STANDARD design system. Exact vocabulary (from app/page.tsx, app/(marketing)/pricing/page.tsx, components/marketing/primitives.tsx, sections.tsx, app/globals.css):

THEME: dark navy bg (bg-navy-950 #060a14 / navy-900 / navy-850), brand violet (#6f47f5, brand-300/400/500), accent-blue (#3b82f6), accent-cyan (#22d3ee), emerald ONLY for game accents, amber ONLY for star ratings. Muted text = text-slate-400. White headings.
SHARED PRIMITIVES pages SHOULD use:
- `.rail` (max-w-6xl px-5) content width
- `<Section tone="base|panel|deep|light" size="sm|md|lg">` bands (primitives.tsx)
- `<PageHero eyebrow title highlight sub primary secondary visual>` with `.hero-aura` for sub-page heroes
- `<SectionTitle eyebrow title sub>` OR `<SectionHeading label title sub>` headings
- `<FeatureCard>`, `<CtaBand>` (sections.tsx)
- `.eyebrow` / `.eyebrow-pill`, `.grad-text`
- `.card` / `.card-hover` / `.lift` / `.glass` surfaces
- `.btn-primary` / `.btn-secondary`
- `<Reveal>`, `<AmbientField>`

INCONSISTENCIES to catalog: off-theme colors (indigo/purple/gray/zinc/sky/teal/raw hex not in palette, bg-black); one-off hero blocks instead of PageHero/hero-aura; hand-rolled containers (mx-auto max-w-* instead of .rail/Section); custom heading markup instead of eyebrow/SectionTitle; spacing/typography drift; ad-hoc card styling instead of .card; outdated/fabricated claims (invented stats, fake uptime/region counts); dated layouts.

AUDIT THESE FILES (read each fully; some import product-specific components like DomainChecker, VpsConfigurator, ProductShowcase, DeployCatalog — flag ONLY if the PAGE-LEVEL markup/hero/sections drift, not the deep internals of those components unless clearly off-theme):
- app/(marketing)/features/page.tsx
- app/(marketing)/developers/page.tsx
- app/(marketing)/vps/page.tsx
- app/(marketing)/web-hosting/page.tsx
- app/(marketing)/business-email/page.tsx
- app/(marketing)/domains/page.tsx
- app/(marketing)/block-storage/page.tsx
- app/(marketing)/nxcloud/page.tsx

For EACH page report: (1) CONSISTENT (leave alone) or NEEDS WORK; (2) specific inconsistencies WITH line numbers + exact snippet; (3) severity HIGH/MED/LOW per finding (HIGH = off-theme/different-site/fabricated claim; MED = structural drift/one-off components; LOW = minor spacing/type); (4) concrete "make it match by ..." fix per finding. Concise and specific. Return findings as final message text grouped by page — write NO files.

content.thinking: So the delay values in web-hosting and nxcloud are way too small—they're passing milliseconds like 0.05ms and 0.1ms which creates essentially no stagger effect, whereas the gold standard pages use something like 60ms and 120ms intervals that actually create a visible cascade.…

content.thinking:
I'm noticing the `.card` class uses rounded corners, a subtle white border, a dark navy background with transparency, padding, a backdrop blur effect, and a shadow. The custom cards in the web-hosting section are trying to replicate this but fall short—they skip the backdrop blur and shadow, use a slightly different border opacity, and a different background shade, making them look less polished overall.

Now I'm organizing my findings by page. The features page is solid—it uses all the approved design components consistently and stays on-brand. The developers page has a couple of issues: there's a fabricated region claim ("eu-central") that contradicts the Singapore-only location stated elsewhere, and some links point to `/docs` which is outdated since documentation moved to `/admin/docs`. The region inconsistency is a higher priority fix, while the broken links are more of a content issue but still worth flagging.

I'm also noting the traffic-light indicator dots on the developers page—they use red, amber, and emerald which technically breaks the color rules (amber and emerald are supposed to be reserved for specific contexts), but since these are mimicking the classic macOS terminal window chrome, it's a borderline case I'll mark as low priority. The code window itself uses the `.glass` primitive which is approved, so that's fine.

Moving to the VPS page, I'm finding fabricated statistics—a "47 second median deploy time" and "99.9% uptime SLA" that have no basis and need to be either removed or replaced with real data.

The web-hosting page has more significant issues: several cards are hand-rolled with custom border and background styles instead of using the `.card` primitive, which means they're missing the backdrop blur, shadow, and proper design system colors. I need to replace those with the card class. There's also a timing problem with the reveal animations—the delays are specified in seconds but should be milliseconds, so they're effectively not staggering at all.

Beyond that, the section sizes default to medium when the other product pages use large for major sections, creating a spacing inconsistency. Some sections also skip the eyebrow label that appears on other pages, though that's less critical.

The business-email and domains pages look solid by comparison—they're using the right primitives, proper millisecond delays, and consistent styling throughout.

Looking at block-storage, it's also clean and consistent with the established patterns. But nxcloud needs attention—same issues as web-hosting with hand-rolled card styling that doesn't match the system.

The main problems: card definitions scattered throughout instead of using the `.card` class, delay values in fractional seconds creating a mismatch with the millisecond convention elsewhere, and the featured plan card using a custom glow treatment instead of the `.card glow-brand` pattern that business-email and block-storage already established. I should standardize these to use the consistent card and glow patterns.…

content.text:
Read complete — all 8 pages plus the four gold-standard sources (primitives.tsx, sections.tsx, Reveal.tsx, globals.css `.card`). Findings grouped by page below. Confirmed facts: `.card` = `rounded-2xl border-white/[0.06] bg-navy-900/70 p-6 backdrop-blur-md` + inset/drop shadow; `Reveal` `delay` is in **milliseconds** (`transitionDelay: ${delay}ms`).

---

## features/page.tsx — CONSISTENT
Textbook use of the system: `PageHero`, `Section` tones, `SectionTitle`, `FeatureCard`, `CtaBand`, plus `.card glow-brand`, `.eyebrow-pill`, `.grad-text`, `.btn-primary`, `.section-label`. The flagship block (L92-136) is bespoke but assembled entirely from approved primitives and on-theme colors (brand violet + accent-blue radial). Location "Singapore" matches the canonical claim. No fixes needed.

---

## developers/page.tsx — NEEDS WORK (content, not layout)
- **HIGH — fabricated/inconsistent region** L67: `"region": "eu-central"` in the sample API response. Every other page states the platform is Singapore-only; this invents a European region. Make it match by changing the sample to the real location (e.g. `"region": "singapore"`).
- **MED — dead link** L99 & L196: `secondary`/CTA point to `/docs`. Per project state the public `/docs` route was retired (docs moved to `/admin/docs`). Make it match by removing the docs CTA or pointing it at the live destination.
- **LOW — off-palette chrome** L79-80: terminal window dots use `bg-red-400/70` and `bg-amber-400/70` (amber is theme-reserved for star ratings; red isn't in the palette). It's a conventional macOS-window idiom so it reads fine, but if strict: recolor to slate/neutral dots. `.glass` code panel itself is an approved primitive — fine.

---

## vps/page.tsx — NEEDS WORK (fabricated stats)
- **HIGH — invented metrics** L138-139: `StatCounter value={47} suffix="s" label="Median deploy time"` and `value={99.9} decimals={1} suffix="%" label="Uptime SLA"`. Both are unsubstantiated (a precise "47s median" and a "99.9% Uptime SLA" with no SLA behind it) — exactly the invented-stat/fake-uptime pattern to avoid. Make it match by dropping the SLA stat unless a real SLA exists, and replacing "47s median" with the copy-supported, honest "Under 60s deploy."

Everything else (hero, pillars, capability grid, DeployCatalog, PricingGrid, FAQ `.card`) is fully on-system.

---

## web-hosting/page.tsx — NEEDS WORK (structural drift; different-hand build)
- **MED — hand-rolled cards instead of `.card`** L84 (steps), L112 (plan cards), L142 (FAQ): all use `rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-navy-850/60 p-6`. This is a lossy reimplementation of `.card` — wrong border opacity (`/[0.08]` vs `/[0.06]`), wrong surface (`navy-850/60` vs `navy-900/70`), and it drops the `backdrop-blur-md` + inset/drop shadow the real card has. Make it match by using `className="card"` (add `card-hover`/`lift` where hover is intended); sibling pages (block-storage, business-email, domains) already do exactly this.
- **LOW — broken stagger (delay unit)** L62-74, L83, L111, L141: `delay={0.05}` / `delay={i * 0.05}`. Delay is milliseconds, so these are ~0ms — no stagger renders. Gold-standard pages use `(i % 3) * 60`. Make it match by switching to ms (`i * 60`).
- **LOW — rhythm drift** L56/L80/L97/L137/L154: `Section` uses the default `md` throughout, while every sibling product page uses `size="lg"` for major bands. Add `size="lg"` for matching vertical rhythm.
- **LOW — headings drop the eyebrow** L57/L81/L98: `SectionTitle` with no `eyebrow`, whereas peers lead each band with one. Add eyebrows for consistency.

---

## business-email/page.tsx — CONSISTENT
Full-system: `PageHero` with visual, `Section` tones, `SectionTitle`, `FeatureCard`, DB-fed pricing on `.card lift` with `glow-brand` for the popular tier, ms-based `delay` (80), `.btn-primary/secondary`, emerald checks. No fixes.

---

## domains/page.tsx — CONSISTENT
`PageHero`, `Section`, `SectionTitle`, `FeatureCard`, cross-sell on `.card lift`, `CtaBand`. The TLD price tiles (L63-72) are bespoke but on-theme (`navy-900/60`, brand hover) and function as price chips rather than content cards — acceptable. No fixes needed.

---

## block-storage/page.tsx — CONSISTENT
`.card lift` for steps and pricing examples, `glow-brand` on the highlighted tier, `FeatureCard` grid, ms-based `delay` (80), all approved primitives. No fixes.

---

## nxcloud/page.tsx — NEEDS WORK (same drift as web-hosting; clearly the same author)
- **MED — hand-rolled cards instead of `.card`** L89 (steps), L108-110 (plan cards), L145 (FAQ): identical `rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-navy-850/60 p-6` reimplementation, losing blur + shadow + correct surface. Make it match by using `.card`.
- **MED — off-pattern featured card** L108-110: the featured plan uses hand-rolled `border-brand-500/50 bg-brand-500/[0.06]`, whereas the established "popular/featured" treatment across the site is `.card lift ... border-brand-500/40 glow-brand` (see business-email L167, block-storage L137). Make it match by adopting the `glow-brand` pattern.
- **LOW — broken stagger (delay unit)** L67-79, L88, L107, L144: `delay={0.05}` / `delay={i * 0.05}` in ms = no stagger. Switch to `i * 60`.
- **LOW — rhythm drift** L61/L85/L98/L140/L157: default `md` `Section` sizing vs siblings' `size="lg"`. Add `size="lg"`.

---

### Cross-cutting takeaway
Six pages (features, developers, vps, business-email, domains, block-storage) are on the design system. The two outliers — **web-hosting** and **nxcloud** — share the same non-system fingerprint (hand-rolled `bg-navy-850/60 p-6` cards, fractional-second `delay` values, default section sizing, eyebrow-less headings) and are the priority remediation targets. Separately, three HIGH content issues to correct regardless of layout: the invented `eu-central` region (developers), and the fabricated `47s median` / `99.9% Uptime SLA` stats (vps).
